title: Constant row of the Vandermonde matrix
statement: Let $k,n$ be positive integers with $k\le n$, and let $d=\max(1,\lceil\log_2 n\rceil)$. For the binary matrix with rows indexed by a constant row and pairs $(q,i)$, where $q\in\{0,\ldots,k-2\}$ and $i\in\{0,\ldots,d-1\}$, and columns indexed by $j\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, the entry in the constant row is $1$ in every column.
hypotheses_covered: $j$ is a column index with $0\le j<n$
